Lena (CS): Quick follow-up from today's outage: we need a short public status, an enterprise-facing briefing template (SLA impact + next steps), owners for remediation tasks, and a clear RCA distribution playbook (who gets redacted RCAs vs. NDA route). Volunteers?

Vik (SRE): I can own remediation. Plan: temp hotfix within 36h, full mitigation (adaptive rate-limits + integration tests) in ~9 days. Filing ticket INC-5120.

Ava (PM): Noting recurrence: similar queue growth seen last quarter. I'll run the retro and add a recurring-incident checklist (tests + runbook updates).

Noah (Comms): Draft short status page copy (keep non-technical):
"Between 09:06 and 09:32 UTC we experienced increased request latency which affected some API requests. A mitigation has been applied and monitoring is ongoing. We will publish an interim summary within 24 hours and a full RCA within 7 business days. If you were impacted, contact support@redwood.ai."

Legal: Public summary is fine. Redacted RCAs can be shared with affected customers after Security review; full raw logs/diagrams only under NDA and Legal sign-off.

redaction-bot: Created INC-5120 in Tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-5120

Vik (SRE): Action items (owners + due dates):
- Vik: hotfix roll 126-07-01126 due 2026-07-02
- Vik: durable fix + tests 126-07-11126 due 2026-07-11
- Ava: retro + recurring-incident doc 126-07-05126 due 2026-07-05
- Noah: publish short status + interim summary 126-07-01126 due 2026-07-01
- Lena: compile affected-customer list for outreach 126-07-01126 due 2026-07-01
- Legal: redaction + NDA process doc 126-07-06126 due 2026-07-06

Ava (PM): Scheduling retro: Wednesday 15:00 PST. Invite SRE, infra-test, CS, Comms, Security, Legal.

Lena (CS): I'll ping AEs for urgent outreach and add affected accounts to INC-5120 once compiled.

Noah (Comms): I'll trim the copy slightly and post the short status now after a 15m review. Will paste the live link here.

redaction-bot: INC-5120 updated: owners assigned (Vik, Ava, Noah, Lena, Legal), due dates set.

Lena (CS): Thanks all 12 we'll track progress in INC-5120 and close the loop here after the retro.
